art_direction: 短高拱眼一边略窄，双瞳向前，笔线不闭合，一眉微抬，无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Use a taller upper arch and a short, almost flat lower mark for each eye. Keep the right opening slightly narrower, not smaller overall. Both large dark pupils face forward and contain a blunt irregular gap of untouched paper. Draw the arches with one quick pen movement, allowing a small change of pressure near the top. A tiny raised brow above the narrower eye supplies attention; the other brow is low. No mouth or extra marks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
